title: [Feature] 添加存储操作的日志记录功能

changes: Added optional `logger` parameter to TodoStorage.__init__ (defaults to None)
load() logs DEBUG message with file path and record count when logger is provided
save() logs DEBUG message with file path and record count when logger is provided
load() logs 0 records when file not found (when logger is provided)
Zero overhead when logger is None (no logging calls made)
